Dataset Summary
	

SWE-ContextBench is a benchmark created to evaluate how well programming agents, such as AI coding systems, can reuse past experience when solving new tasks. It is built on top of existing datasets including SWE-Bench Lite, SWE-Bench Multilingual, and SWE-Bench Verified. The dataset contains 1,007 base tasks along with 362 related tasks that are derived from real dependency and reference relationships among GitHub issues and pull requests.
